item.title: Late-term abortion facility scrubs Georgetown from website after denying affiliation
item.description: A Maryland abortion facility recently removed a reference to Georgetown University in a "training" section on its website after The College Fix began asking questions. The Catholic institution strongly denied ever having had a relationship with the abortion facility.

item.title: Indian students reach settlement with CU Boulder over ‘pungent’ food dispute
item.description: Two Indian graduate students recently settled a lawsuit with CU Boulder over allegedly discriminatory treatment related to them heating Indian food in a department microwave.

item.title: Harvard-backed program drops ‘students of color’ requirement after legal complaint

item.title: ‘Crisis’ in college math readiness prompts probe by Senator Bill Cassidy
item.description: Senator Bill Cassidy wants to find out why math skills are so bad at some colleges.

item.title: Harvard gives fewer As after report exposed massive grade inflation: dean
item.description: Harvard University has reduced the number of A grades by about 7 percent amid concerns about grade inflation. Dean Amanda Claybaugh emphasized the need for academic rigor and plans to review grading policies, acknowledging faculty concerns over teaching evaluations and the effects on student enrollment.

item.description: Colorado of School of Mines suggests race and sexuality play a role in hiring.

item.title: U. New Hampshire student-turned state lawmaker pushing for ‘campus carry’ law
item.description: New Hampshire state Rep. Samuel Farrington, who's also a college student, has introduced a "campus carry" bill to allow students to carry firearms on public campuses. The bill has received support from students and some faculty at UNH.

item.description: 'There has been zero soul searching and zero rethinking,' one MIT source said.
